question: Which among the following rivers originates in Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Godavari River rises from Trimbakeshwar in the Nashik district of Maharashtra.
 
• It is the oldest River in India.
 
• It is also known as the Ganga of South India.
 
• It is the second-longest river in India.
 
• Dams on the Godavari river are - Polavaram Dam (Andhra Prades
